decisions.reason: The platform consequence is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; no additional MODIFY is needed.
Making the spout flush with the machine bottom and adding a clearance platform does not change the spout cleaning or removability requirements.
The source changes spout placement and cup clearance, not the required leak-free seal behavior.
The new platform may require additional materials or BOM documentation, but the source does not establish whether it uses existing materials or requires a revised component list.
Spout mounting height and the external cup platform do not change mixing, frothing, whisk, or foam-performance requirements.
The platform preserves physical cup access without changing the solenoid control, dispensing sequence, flow rate, or texture-preservation behavior.
The source does not alter the requirement to prevent liquid from entering the base or electrical components.
The spout and platform decision does not change placard text, placement, or viewing orientation.
A passive support platform does not entail a change to electrical loads, power capacity, controllers, or overload margin.
The source changes external spout clearance and support height, not bowl capacity, depth, or well geometry.
The platform and spout mounting decision does not affect whisk removal, tool-free detachment, or bowl-removal clearance.
The platform may need to be incorporated into the system layout or enclosure CAD, but the source does not determine whether it is a separate accessory or part of the CAD deliverable.
